ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.22:0.78 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-contrast white cluster at the distal-lateral margin of the left lobe; fragmented white stippling along the trailing edge of the right lobe; homogenous low-intensity black pigmentation throughout the central and basal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 68 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the continuous trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity observed at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve characterized by convex lateral lobes transitioning to a concave sweep as they approach the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels on the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner medial surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular white pigmentation/scarring along the trailing edge of both lobes; distinct linear streak on the interior left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Singular high-intensity white focal spot located at the base of the peduncle junction.
